title: Inner-Learning: From Hand-Coded Beliefs to Declarative Knowledge in Trick-Taking Games
abstract: arXiv:2610.38304v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a declarative approach to belief-state modeling in trick-taking card games. Starting from a state-of-the-art Skat player, we automatically extract its hand-coded inference rules into a domain-specific language built on the primitive $\neg\mathsf{holds}(P,C)$, denoting that player $P$ cannot hold any card in set $C$. Round-trip code generation verifies that the extracted rules reproduce the original engine's intended behavior, up to three audited bugs in the original that the declarative engine corrects. We then grow the rule base through symmetric derivation and annotation of an expert strategy document---unifying code, symmetry, and expertise in one representation. We extend the knowledge representation with \emph{cardinality constraints}: at-most-$k$ and at-least-$k$ bounds on the cards a player holds from a named group, expressed in the same declarative language and enforced at world-generation time. translated_title: 内学习：吃墩类纸牌游戏中从手工编码信念到声明式知识
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种用于吃墩类纸牌游戏中信念状态建模的声明式方法。以最先进的斯卡特牌（Skat）程序为起点，我们自动将其手工编写的推理规则提取到一种领域特定语言中，该语言建立在原语 ¬holds(P,C) 之上，表示玩家 P 不可能持有集合 C 中的任何牌。往返代码生成验证了提取出的规则能够复现原引擎的预期行为——仅有原引擎中经审计确认的三处缺陷，而声明式引擎对此进行了修正。随后，我们通过对称推导以及对专家策略文档的注释来扩充规则库，从而将代码、对称性与专家经验统一到同一种表示之中。我们还用“基数约束”扩展了知识表示：对玩家从某个指定牌组中所持牌数量施加至多 k 与至少 k 的界限，以同样的声明式语言表达，并在世界生成时加以执行。置信度参数……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种声明式方法，将最先进斯卡特牌程序中手工编写的信念推理规则自动提取为基于 ¬holds(P,C) 原语的领域特定语言，并通过对称推导、专家知识注释和基数约束扩展规则库，从而统一代码、对称性与专家经验，同时修正了原引擎中经审计确认的三处缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a declarative approach that automatically extracts hand-coded belief inference rules from a state-of-the-art Skat player into a domain-specific language built on the primitive ¬holds(P,C), further enriching the rule base through symmetric derivation, expert strategy annotation, and cardinality constraints, thereby unifying code, symmetry, and expertise while correcting three audited bugs in the original engine.
